mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, we are looking at clear skies at Harriet Park, and if you look up tonight, the space station will be visible starting at 7:40 PM, moving from over Mount Horeb toward the northeast near Home Depot in Madison.

Regarding city news, officers were called to Hunter's Cove Way on September 10 for a burglary. The suspect, a 19-year-old from Madison, was taken into custody after a weapon was recovered, and he is currently facing charges for burglary and recklessly endangering safety.

There is plenty to do, including the Ironman Wisconsin Loop Festival today. You can also catch live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company today, followed by yoga tomorrow at Insight Wellness and various trivia nights starting Monday.

On September 10, the Verona police department handled a burglary incident on Hunter's Cove Way, which resulted in the suspect being taken to a hospital for treatment before being booked into the Dane County Jail.
Today's flavor of the day is Really Reese's. The restaurant is currently open, so stop by anytime before 10:00 PM to grab a scoop.
